problem_text:
A logistics firm is assembling a specialized cargo shipment to maximize total profit while adhering to a strict weight ceiling for the transport vehicle.

The available cargo units are:
* Unit A: weight 25kg, profit 283 monetary units
* Unit B: weight 1kg, profit 76 monetary units
* Unit C: weight 8kg, profit 112 monetary units
* Unit D: weight 6kg, profit 248 monetary units
* Unit E: weight 13kg, profit 10 monetary units
* Unit F: weight 34kg, profit 222 monetary units
* Unit G: weight 5kg, profit 284 monetary units
* Unit H: weight 12kg, profit 129 monetary units
* Unit I: weight 15kg, profit 222 monetary units
* Unit J: weight 25kg, profit 253 monetary units
* Unit K: weight 1kg, profit 233 monetary units
* Unit L: weight 14kg, profit 205 monetary units
* Unit M: weight 49kg, profit 31 monetary units
* Unit N: weight 40kg, profit 147 monetary units
* Unit O: weight 2kg, profit 187 monetary units

Furthermore, due to contractual obligations, exactly one of Unit A and Unit B must be included in the shipment.

If Unit C is selected, the effective weight capacity of the vehicle is diminished by 10 kg.
The vehicle can accommodate a maximum of 175 kg. The firm must determine which cargo units to load.
